prompt: Write 5 short claim log entries by an auto insurance adjuster for a parking lot collision claim. Injury: whiplash. The claimant is not represented by a lawyer. Start each entry on a new line with 'Entry 1:', 'Entry 2:' and so on. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1128; do not mention it.)
text:
Entry 1: Claim opened following a report of a low-speed collision in a retail parking lot. Insured vehicle was reversing from a space when contact occurred with the claimant's parked vehicle. Claimant reports neck pain and stiffness and states they were seen at an urgent care facility. Claimant has not retained legal counsel at this time. Initial contact made by phone; claimant is cooperative and prefers email for follow-up.

Entry 2: Reviewed photos submitted by both parties. Minor scuffing and a cracked rear bumper cover on the claimant's vehicle, with light paint transfer on the insured's front bumper. Police were not called and no report was filed, as both drivers exchanged information at the scene. Liability appears probable against the insured based on the reversing maneuver, pending the insured's statement.

Entry 3: Received the claimant's medical documentation from the urgent care visit. Diagnosis noted as cervical strain consistent with whiplash. Treatment included a prescription for muscle relaxants and a recommendation for physical therapy. Claimant has not yet scheduled therapy and reports ongoing discomfort when turning the head. Bodily injury evaluation placed on hold until treatment progress is documented.

Entry 4: Spoke with the claimant regarding the status of the file. Explained the process for submitting medical bills and wage loss forms, if applicable. Claimant asked general questions about timing and about how the bodily injury portion is evaluated. Provided the standard claimant information packet and advised that they may consult an attorney at any time should they choose to do so. Claimant acknowledged receipt.

Entry 5: Follow-up with the claimant to check on symptoms and therapy scheduling. Claimant reports partial improvement and has begun physical therapy sessions. Requested itemized receipts and records from the provider. Reserve reviewed and kept at current level pending receipt of documentation. Next review scheduled for a later date once treatment records are complete.
